Opening01 / 08

A cat has nine styles.一隻貓有九種造型。

In a feed full of AI slop, nobody wants to make more. Make choices instead.動態牆上滿是AI垃圾內容，沒有人想再多做一支。那就從做選擇開始。

Slop has a dictionary definition now. Merriam-Webster made it the word of 2025: digital content of low quality that is produced usually in quantity by means of artificial intelligence. In a June 2026 test, Kapwing found that 294 of the first 500 videos TikTok showed a brand-new account, 59%, were slop.「slop」（AI垃圾內容）現在有字典定義了。韋氏字典把它選為2025年度代表字：「品質低落、通常由人工智慧大量產出的數位內容」。2026年6月，Kapwing用一個全新的TikTok帳號測試，系統推給它的前500支影片裡，有294支、也就是59%是這種內容。

People notice. In Animoto's 2026 survey, 83% of US consumers said they had watched a video they suspected was AI, and the giveaways they named were robotic gestures, unnatural voices and no emotional tone. A study of AI-labelled paintings points the same way: people liked them less than the same paintings labelled human, but how much story and effort they saw in a painting changed how much the label mattered.觀眾都看在眼裡。Animoto 2026年的調查中，83%的美國消費者說看過自己懷疑是AI做的影片，他們點出的破綻是：動作僵硬、聲音不自然、沒有情緒。一項關於AI畫作的研究也指向同一件事：同一幅畫，標成AI做的就比標成人畫的不受喜愛；但大家在畫裡看到多少故事、多少用心，會影響這個標籤的分量。

A picture reads as slop when nobody seems to have made a choice. This issue is about making them. It takes one scene through nine styles, two cats boxing over a warm spot on the duvet, three drawn in code and six generated, and shows how each was made and what kind of job that look suits.當一張圖看起來沒有人做過任何選擇，它就成了垃圾內容。這期講的就是怎麼做選擇：把同一個場景畫成九種畫風，兩隻貓在棉被上為了一塊暖暖的位子出拳打架，三張用程式畫，六張用AI生成，告訴妳每一張怎麼做出來，以及那種畫風適合什麼樣的案子。

Meet the cast登場角色

Brownie (布朗尼), the little sister. Long and lanky, tufted ears, a dark tabby with big yellow-green eyes. Starts every fight. Sis! Come play!布朗尼，妹妹。身形修長、耳朵有簇毛，深色虎斑，黃綠色的大眼睛。每次都是她先開戰。台詞：「姐姐！來玩啊！」

Herja (灰灰), the big sister. Round, fluffy, blue-grey, amber eyes usually half shut. Ignores her sister until she doesn't. Here we go again...灰灰，姐姐。圓滾滾、毛蓬蓬，藍灰色，琥珀色的眼睛總是半閉。平常不理妹妹，直到忍不住為止。台詞：「妳又來了……」

Meet the cast02 / 08

Cute, but still your cat.可愛，但還是妳家那隻貓。

Six passes. The first five each failed in a way worth knowing.改了六版，前五版失敗的地方都值得記下來。

Drag through the six passes拖動看六個版本
123456

1–2

The personality, but not the cats個性對了，貓不對

The first drafts got the attitude right: a smug little sister, a bored big sister. But they didn't look like the real cats. Before polishing a style, check the likeness against the photos.最早的草稿抓到了態度：得意的妹妹、無聊的姐姐，但看起來不像那兩隻真貓。風格還沒修之前，先拿照片對一下像不像。

3

The right markings, the wrong mood花紋對了，表情錯了

Copying the photos gave Herja a dark V of fur above her eyes. On a real cat it's just fur. On a cartoon face it reads as a frown, and calm Herja looked sad. So draw the temperament the owner describes, and leave out marks that just happen to show in a photo.照著照片畫，灰灰眼睛上方多了一道深色的V字毛。真貓身上那只是毛色，放到卡通臉上就變成皺眉，冷靜的灰灰看起來很難過。所以要照主人說的脾氣來畫，照片上剛好拍到的毛色就別照抄了。

4

Colours from the photos, and the rules of cute顏色取自照片，再加上「可愛」的規則

The colours were sampled straight from the photos. The faces followed the "baby schema" that makes animals look young: a big round head, eyes and mouth low and close together, a small nose. And a caricature exaggerates only what makes this cat different from an average cat: Brownie's lanky body and ear tufts, Herja's roundness.顏色直接從照片取樣。臉照著讓動物看起來年幼的「嬰兒基模」來畫：大大的圓頭，眼睛和嘴巴的位置低、彼此靠近，小鼻子。漫畫只誇大這隻貓跟一般貓不一樣的地方：布朗尼的長身體和耳朵簇毛，灰灰的圓。

5

Circles, not triangles用圓形，不用三角形

Round shapes read as friendly and spiky ones as menacing, so the spiky fur outlines went and the ear tips got rounded. Heads became mochi, wider at the cheeks. Each got blush under the eyes and a thick dark outline. One small catch: a tail wrapped across the front of the body looked like a flexed arm, so tails now rise behind.圓的形狀看起來友善，尖的看起來有威脅，所以刺刺的毛邊拿掉了，耳尖也修圓。頭變成麻糬形，臉頰比較寬。眼睛下加上腮紅，外框是粗粗的深色線。還有一個小插曲：繞到身體前面的尾巴，看起來像在秀手臂的肌肉，所以尾巴改成從身後翹起來。

6

A wobbly line抖動的線

We found this one while finishing the issue. A filter nudges every edge of the finished art a little, the way a hand would. The design is unchanged, and the cats now look hand-drawn. Some readers will still prefer pass 5, so drag back and compare.這一版是做到最後才發現的。用一個濾鏡把完成的圖每條邊都輕輕推一下，像手畫的一樣。設計完全沒變，貓卻多了手繪感。也許有人比較喜歡第5版，拖回去比比看。

The character sheet角色設定圖

Why the sheet matters為什麼要做角色設定圖

A character sheet is the cast written down: front, side and back views, the faces, the colours as hex codes, and a short list of don'ts. Coded art reads it as numbers. Generated art gets it as the first reference picture in every prompt.角色設定圖就是把角色寫下來：正面、側面、背面、各種表情、顏色的色碼，再加一張「不要這樣畫」的清單。用程式畫的時候，它是一組數字；用AI生成的時候，它是每個提示詞的第一張參考圖。

Swap the faces換表情

Coded faces swap for free: same body, new face, nothing to redraw.程式畫的表情可以免費替換：身體不變，換張臉，什麼都不用重畫。

The gallery03 / 08

Same scene, nine looks.同一個場景，九種畫風。

Round 3. The champion finally gets up.第三回合，衛冕者總算站起來了。

The scene is the climax of the cats' short: both up on their hind legs on the duvet, each landing a paw on the other's cheek, the warm spot glowing empty between them. Brownie stands on the left and Herja on the right in every version, so you can flip between them and see only the style change.這個場景是短片的高潮：兩隻貓在棉被上站起來，各自一掌打在對方臉上，中間那塊暖暖的位子空著發亮。每個版本裡，布朗尼都在左邊、灰灰都在右邊，所以來回切換時，變的只有畫風。

Three were drawn in code: the sticker style, the 16-bit fighting game and the Cubist one. Six were generated as images: the comic strip, the 4-koma manga, needle felt, ukiyo-e, the Victorian engraving and the photoreal cats. The score bug and the caption are the same code layer on all nine. No words were generated.其中三張是用程式畫的：貼圖風、16位元格鬥遊戲、立體派。另外六張是AI生成的：美式漫畫、四格漫畫、羊毛氈、浮世繪、維多利亞版畫，還有寫實照片風。比分條和字幕在九張上都是同一層程式，沒有一個字是生成出來的。

The photoreal frame is here for comparison. It's the version closest to what fills the feeds, and the one most likely to be scrolled past as slop.寫實照片風放在這裡是為了比較。它是最接近動態牆上那些影片的版本，也最可能被當成AI垃圾內容直接滑過去。

Method04 / 08

Coded or generated?用程式畫，還是交給AI生成？

Code keeps your cast steady; generation makes it look like the real thing. Most projects need both.程式讓角色穩定，AI讓角色像本人。大部分作品兩種都需要。

Turn the rules on啟用規則

A style is a short list of rules.畫風就是一張短短的規則清單。

Flat fill or brush fill, a clean line or a wobbly one, paper grain or none. Turn the rules on one at a time and watch the same cats change.平塗還是筆刷、乾淨的線還是抖動的線、有沒有紙紋。一次啟用一條規則，看同樣兩隻貓怎麼變。

What this issue taught us, one lesson per example這期學到的事，一個例子一課

Code gives control; generation gives likeness程式給妳控制權，AI給妳相似度

The coded cats never drift, and swapping a face costs nothing. But after five passes they still looked like cartoon cats more than these two cats. The generated cats looked like the real ones on the first try, because they had the photos to work from.程式畫的貓永遠不會跑掉，換表情也不花成本。但改了五版，看起來還是比較像卡通貓，不太像這兩隻。AI生成的貓第一次就很像真貓，因為它有照片可以參考。

Code can carry a whole style when the style is shapes畫風如果是形狀，程式就能一手包辦

Stickers, pixels and Cubism are all flat shapes and clear rules, and code draws them well. Fur, felt and paint can be coded too, but you have to code every detail. We've seen a Van Gogh game built in WebGL2 from hundreds of thousands of brush strokes, each one a small shape that a shader paints with bristle marks. On a strong machine it looks wonderful. On an ordinary one, it has to drop its resolution to keep moving.貼圖、像素、立體派，都是平面形狀加明確規則，程式畫得很好。毛、羊毛氈、顏料筆觸也寫得出來，但每個細節都得自己寫。我們看過一款用WebGL2做的梵谷遊戲，畫面由幾十萬筆筆觸構成，每一筆都是一個小形狀，再由著色器畫出刷毛的紋理。效能好的電腦跑起來很美；一般的電腦就得降低解析度才跑得動。

Code makes the anchor; generation follows it程式畫定錨圖，AI跟著它走

One composition frame drawn in code went into the prompt for every generated style, together with photos of the real cats. That's why the staging held in every one: Brownie left, Herja right, the cross-counter, the empty spot.一張用程式畫的構圖，加上真貓的照片，放進每一種生成畫風的提示詞裡。所以每一張的站位都沒跑：布朗尼在左、灰灰在右、交叉反擊、中間空著的位子。

Words, meters and captions stay in code文字、量表和字幕都留給程式

The score bug, the caption and the fighting game's PATIENCE bar are code layers on top of the picture. Image models still misspell, and code can switch languages.比分條、字幕、格鬥遊戲的「耐心」條，都是疊在圖上的程式圖層。圖像模型還是會拼錯字，而程式可以切換語言。

Hybrids work混著用也行

The 16-bit frame is the vector cats shrunk onto a pixel palette, with the stage and the health bars pixelled by hand. It works the other way too: a generated picture can become 16-bit pixel art the same way, as Kettlebrook's cards do in Chapter 5.16位元那張，是把向量畫的貓縮到像素調色盤上，舞台和血條再一格一格手工點出來。反過來也可以：AI生成的圖，也能用同樣的方法變成16位元像素畫，第5章的Kettlebrook神諭卡就是這樣做的。

The style has to live in the cats, not only the room畫風要畫在貓身上，不能只畫在房間裡

In the first round, the comic strip and the ukiyo-e came back with the same realistic fur as the Victorian engraving, so the style showed only in the background. Describing how the cats themselves are drawn, and leaving the photos out of those two prompts, fixed it. Their markings went into the words instead.第一輪的美式漫畫和浮世繪，貓的毛都跟維多利亞版畫一樣寫實，畫風只出現在背景。改成描述貓本身怎麼畫，並拿掉這兩種畫風提示詞裡的照片，就好了；貓的花紋改用文字描述。

Some things generation still can't do reliably有些事AI還是做不穩

Two crossing arms in a woodblock print took nine tries for one ukiyo-e frame. Each rewording moved the mistake instead of fixing it: a floating arm, a see-through arm, an extra arm, two arms merged into one.兩隻交叉的手臂，放在木刻版畫裡，一張浮世繪試了九次。每改一次措辭，錯誤只是換個地方：飄著的手、透明的手、多一隻手、兩隻手黏成一隻。

Fix small flaws by editing, not regenerating小瑕疵用修圖，不要重新生成

The keeper had one wrong-coloured paw. We asked for an edit of that picture, then pasted back only the paw.最後選定的那張只有一隻腳掌顏色不對。我們請AI修改那張圖，然後只把腳掌那一塊貼回去。

Cost: test cheap, then rerun the keepers省錢：先用便宜的試，再重跑選中的

Every style ran first at the cheapest setting, and only the picks were rerun at a better one. How you test cheap depends on the model you use.每種畫風都先用最便宜的設定跑一輪，只有選中的才用比較好的設定重跑。怎麼便宜地試，要看妳用的是哪個模型。

Generated art → coded art從AI圖到程式圖
Drag the line拖動分隔線
Coded程式GeneratedAI

Can you trace a generated picture into code? An auto-trace copied our comic strip closely, but it melted: soft blobby outlines, smeared eyes, and no parts to move. Redrawing it by hand in code, with the generated picture as the model, took two passes and gave us cats with real arms and tails. More detail only takes more passes. Re-posing is harder, because tabby stripes change with every angle.AI生成的圖，能不能描成程式？自動描圖把我們的美式漫畫描得很像，但它是「融化」的：輪廓軟爛、眼睛糊掉，也沒有可以動的部位。改成用程式手工重畫，拿生成的圖當參考，兩版之後就有了真的手臂和尾巴。細節多畫幾版就能補上；換姿勢比較難，因為虎斑的條紋每換一個角度都會變。

Choosing05 / 08

Which look for which job?什麼案子，配什麼畫風？

Ask four questions: who it's for, what it's for, what it says, and what you can build.問四個問題：給誰看、拿來做什麼、要說什麼、妳做得出來什麼。

Every InkQuest project started from those four questions, and they gave very different answers.InkQuest的每個作品都從這四個問題開始，答案差很多。

LENS: ink and wash for the newsLENS：用鋼筆淡彩插畫講時事

LENS covers real topics for adult learners: teenage girl idols, falling house prices, fortune-telling, romance novels. One calm ink-and-wash look, drawn in code, keeps the focus on the ideas, and every issue keeps that one style. Its charts and diagrams are built in code too, so every word on them can switch to Chinese.LENS給成人學習者讀真實議題：少女偶像、房價下跌、占卜、言情小說。一種沉穩的鋼筆淡彩風格，用程式畫，讓注意力留在內容上，每期都維持同一種畫風。圖表也用程式做，所以上面每個字都能切換成中文。

Kettlebrook: cozy 16-bit for a game worldKettlebrook：遊戲世界用溫馨的16位元

The oracle deck's 36 cards were generated as paintings, then run through a pixel pass: shrunk to 240 × 360 with one shared set of 128 colours. The frames, numbers and names were added in code, so all 36 match and the names change language.神諭卡的36張牌先用AI生成繪畫，再做「像素化」：縮成240 × 360，共用同一組128色。牌框、編號和名字是程式加上去的，所以36張完全一致，名字也能切換語言。

Window Seat: from coded pixels to generated onesWindow Seat：從程式像素到生成像素

The Window Seat textbooks have 8-bit graphics drawn in code and chiptune music. Their companion game started out the same way, one step up: 16-bit graphics drawn in code, with FM-synth music. Then a student said she didn't like the coded 16-bit look of The Villainess Has Read the Book, another of our games, and she probably wouldn't like this game's either. The coded look had also hit its limits: it just wasn't pretty enough. So the game's art moved to generated pictures turned into pixel art, inside screens that look like a cozy notebook.《窗邊英文》課本用的是程式畫的8位元圖像，配上晶片音樂。搭配的遊戲一開始也走同一條路，只是升了一級：程式畫的16位元圖像，配FM合成音樂。後來有位學生說，她不喜歡我們另一款遊戲《反派千金讀過原著》那種程式畫的16位元風格，那她大概也不會喜歡這款遊戲的畫面。程式畫的風格也碰到了極限：就是不夠好看。所以遊戲的圖改成AI生成，再轉成像素畫，放進像溫馨手帳一樣的畫面裡。

LENS No. 04: paper cut-outs on a stageLENS第4期：舞台上的紙片

The toy theater lets readers build a romance novel from paper pieces: a heroine, a love interest, a setting, a trope. Paper fits a toy, and every piece is a separate drawing that can be moved.紙劇場讓讀者用紙片組一本言情小說：女主角、男主角、場景、套路。紙很適合做玩具，而且每一片都是可以移動的獨立圖。

Painterly stills for tense, emotional moments and for explainers有戲劇張力的畫面和解說影片，用繪畫感的靜態圖

Feelings and faces close up are where generated painting earns its place. LENS No. 03's explainer video is generated stills with code on top: the moving cards, the charts, the subtitles.情緒和臉部特寫，是AI繪畫最值得用的地方。LENS第3期的解說影片，就是AI生成的靜態圖，再疊上程式做的會動的牌、圖表和字幕。

Pictures that explain會解釋的圖

When a picture has to explain, build it in code: bars that grow, labels on the chart itself, every word in both languages. A generated chart looks right and gets the numbers wrong.當圖是用來解釋事情的，就用程式做：會長高的長條、直接標在圖上的標籤、每個字都有中英文。AI生成的圖表看起來煞有其事，數字卻是錯的。

What a style tells people畫風會說話

A style tells viewers how to read a picture. In a 2013 study, viewers rated the faces of stylized animated characters as more sincere and more intense, and realistic ones as more typical. And a 2026 ombudsman report for a Taiwan news channel advised that when no reporter saw an event, the illustration should use an abstract style, with less colour and less detail, so nobody takes it for footage.畫風會告訴觀眾該怎麼讀一張圖。2013年的一項研究發現，觀眾覺得風格化動畫角色的表情比較真誠、比較強烈，寫實角色的表情則比較「典型」。台灣一家新聞台2026年的公評人報告也建議：記者沒有親眼看到的事件，示意圖應該用抽象的風格，降低彩度、減少細節，免得被當成真實畫面。

Toys06 / 08

Make it something to play with.做成可以玩的東西。

A toy is the best way to show a style off: readers touch it, again and again.展示畫風最好的方法，是做成玩具：讀者會一直去碰它。

The Kettlebrook Oracle凱托溪神諭卡

Shuffle, draw, read. The pixel cards from Chapter 5 became a deck you can actually use.洗牌、抽牌、解牌。第5章的像素牌，變成一副真的能用的牌。

Open it in LENS No. 03 ↗在LENS第3期打開

The LENS No. 04 toy theaterLENS第4期紙劇場

Six slots, six paper pieces each. Fill the stage, raise the curtain, and read the blurb of a novel that will never exist.六個位子，每個位子六張紙片。放滿舞台、拉開布幕，讀一本永遠不會出版的小說的封底文案。

Open it in LENS No. 04 ↗在LENS第4期打開
Brownie Pokes Herja布朗尼戳灰灰
Play full screen ↗全螢幕玩

You're Brownie's accomplice. Every poke scores a point. Poke too far and Herja snaps, and you lose the round's pokes. Watch her face: she'll warn you, more or less. Back off in time and you keep them.妳是布朗尼的共犯。每戳一下得一分。戳過頭，灰灰會爆氣，這回合的分數就全沒了。看她臉色，她會先警告妳，大概吧。及時收手，分數就是妳的。

Why only the sticker style?為什麼只有貼圖風？

The game needs every pose and every face: asleep, annoyed, sighing, standing up to box. Coded art makes those once and reuses them forever. A generated style would need a new picture for each one, and they'd have to match.遊戲需要每一種姿勢和表情：睡著、不耐煩、嘆氣、站起來出拳。程式畫的圖做一次就能一直重複用。AI生成的畫風，每一個都要重新畫一張，而且還得彼此一致。

Motion07 / 08

A funny short, no video generator.不用影片生成器，也能做搞笑短片。

Draw the cast once, then move the pieces.角色畫一次，然後讓零件動起來。

Have real clips? Start there.有真實影片？就從那裡開始。

With feeds this full of generated video, real footage of your own cats is the best material you have. As Animoto's report put it, audiences still want what's real. So let AI help with the edit: finding the funny moments, trimming, setting the pacing, adding captions and music. The cats stay real, the story stays yours, and AI just makes the work faster. Draw or generate only the scenes a camera can't catch, like two cats in a title fight.動態牆上滿是AI生成的影片，這時候，自家貓咪的真實影片就是妳最好的素材。Animoto的報告也說，觀眾還是想看真的東西。所以讓AI幫忙剪輯就好：找出好笑的片段、修剪、抓節奏、加上字幕和音樂。貓是真的，故事是妳的，AI只是讓工作快一點。只有鏡頭拍不到的畫面，像兩隻貓的冠軍賽，才需要用畫的或用生成的。

The Title Fight for the Warm Spot is about 30 seconds long and made entirely in code. Every cat is a sticker drawing in separate layers: a body, an arm that pokes, a face that swaps. A web page moves the layers over time, a renderer saves each frame, and the sound is synthesized: a rice-bowl bell, boops, a thwack, a snore. The deadpan commentary is a computer voice.《暖暖位子爭奪戰》長約30秒，全部用程式做。每隻貓都是分成好幾層的貼圖：身體、會戳人的手、會換的表情。網頁讓這些圖層隨時間移動，再一格一格存成影片。聲音也是合成的：飯碗敲出的鐘聲、戳人的音效、出拳聲、打呼聲。面無表情的旁白是電腦語音。

Why the sticker style? Because it's coded, every pose and every face stays under control from shot to shot. The cartoon shapes suit Brownie's goofy face and her pokes. And the look is a little rough by today's standards, which works in the short's favour: it says this is for fun, don't take it too seriously, and keeps your eyes on the story between two cats. A photoreal version of the same short would be the one most likely to look like slop.為什麼用貼圖風？因為是程式畫的，每個姿勢、每個表情，每一個鏡頭都在掌控之中。卡通的造型很適合布朗尼的呆萌表情和她戳人的樣子。以現在的標準來看，這種畫風有點粗糙，但對這支短片反而是加分：它在說「這只是好玩，別太認真」，讓妳的注意力留在兩隻貓之間的故事上。同一支短片如果做成寫實照片風，反而最可能看起來像AI垃圾內容。

The jokes came from research into viral two-pet videos笑點來自我們對爆紅雙寵物影片的研究
A contrasting pair. Calm big sister, chaotic little sister.反差組合。冷靜的姐姐，搗蛋的妹妹。
Something small to fight over. One warm spot on the duvet.一個小小的爭奪目標。棉被上那塊暖暖的位子。
A borrowed frame. Deadpan sports commentary over a nap squabble.借來的框架。用一本正經的運動轉播，講一場爭奪午覺位子的小吵小鬧。
The payoff. The patient one finally snaps, and while they box, nobody guards the spot.收線。一直忍的那個終於爆發，兩隻打起來的時候，位子沒人顧了。
It works on mute. Every line is also a caption.關掉聲音也看得懂。每一句話都有字幕。
Other ways to make a short without a video generator其他不用影片生成器的做法
1

Motion comic動態漫畫

Stills or layers that slide, zoom and swap, like the Title Fight.靜態圖或圖層滑動、放大、切換，像《暖暖位子爭奪戰》。

2

Pixel cutscene像素過場

Sprites on a stage, a few frames each, like an old game.舞台上的小人物，每個只有幾格動作，像老遊戲。

3

Paper-cut diorama紙雕立體場景

Flat drawings stood up in a 3D set, with a camera that moves.平面的圖立在3D場景裡，鏡頭可以移動。

4

Explainer解說影片

Generated stills with charts, captions and a voice on top, like LENS No. 03's video.AI生成的靜態圖，加上圖表、字幕和旁白，像LENS第3期的影片。

And video generators?那影片生成器呢？

Video generators such as Seedance turn a still into motion. Video generation is a whole topic of its own.像Seedance這類影片生成器，可以把靜態圖變成動態畫面。影片生成是另一個完整的主題。

Your kit08 / 08

A humanizer for pictures.圖像也需要「去AI味」。

The glitches are disappearing. The defaults aren't.破綻越來越少，預設值卻還在。

Writers run drafts through a humanizer to catch the patterns that give AI text away. Checklists for pictures exist too, but they age fast. The old tells, six fingers, garbled signs, faces that melt between frames, are what each new model fixes first, and newer video models already get lighting, objects and motion blur right.寫文章的人會用「去AI味」工具，抓出一看就是AI寫的句型。圖像也有這類檢查清單，只是過時得很快。老破綻像六根手指、亂碼招牌、在畫格之間融化的臉，都是每一代新模型最先修好的地方；新的影片模型連光線、物件和動態模糊都已經做對了。

What lasts is the default: what a model gives you when nobody decides otherwise. Researchers at Northwestern University found that AI images slipped past people more often once the overly cinematic style was toned down. China's AI short dramas show the other side. In the first quarter of 2026, about 122,000 of the 128,000 micro-dramas released there were made with AI, and viewers started complaining about the "AI face": the same round eyes, high nose and pointed chin in every show, with exaggerated gestures on faces that stay stiff. Of the 221,900 AI dramas and comics released in the first half of 2026, only 0.47% passed 100 million plays.真正留下來的是「預設值」：沒有人另外決定時，模型給妳的東西。美國西北大學的研究者發現，只要把過度電影感的風格調淡，AI圖就更常騙過觀眾。中國的AI短劇則是反面的例子。2026年第一季，當地上線的12.8萬部微短劇裡，約有12.2萬部是AI做的，觀眾開始抱怨「AI臉」：每部劇都是同樣的圓眼睛、高鼻梁、尖下巴，動作誇張，臉卻僵硬。2026年上半年推出的22.19萬部AI短劇和AI漫畫裡，播放量破一億的只有0.47%。

So a humanizer for pictures doesn't hunt for glitches. It replaces each default with a decision:所以圖像的「去AI味」，不是去抓破綻，而是把每一個預設值換成一個決定：

Tick each one for your own picture or clip拿妳自己的圖或影片，一項一項打勾

Your style card妳的畫風卡

A style card is where your choices live: the palette as hex codes, the line, the fill, the light, the shapes, your characters' reference pictures, and a list of defaults you've replaced. Hand it to whoever draws next, a person, your code or an image model, and the pictures match.畫風卡是存放妳所有選擇的地方：色碼、線條、上色方式、光線、形狀、角色的參考圖，還有一張妳已經換掉的預設值清單。下一個畫圖的不管是人、妳的程式，還是圖像模型，交給它，畫出來就會一致。

How to use it怎麼用

  1. Fill in the card, or start from one of the nine looks in this issue.填好畫風卡，或從這期的九種畫風挑一個開始。
  2. Draw or generate one anchor picture and check it against the card.畫一張或生成一張定錨圖，拿來對照畫風卡。
  3. Attach the anchor and your character sheets to every prompt after it.之後每一個提示詞，都附上定錨圖和角色設定圖。
  4. Keep words, numbers and captions in code.文字、數字和字幕都留在程式裡。
  5. Before you post, go through the five defaults once more.發布之前，把五個預設值再檢查一次。
